data.spiritual_significance: The name "Tabbu" can symbolize the concept of Tawheed, or the oneness of God. Just as a single drop of water gathers and forms into a bead, the individual self (known as the " dropping" or "self") gathers and forms into one single unit when submitted to Allah (known as the "ocean" or " Allah"). This concept emphasizes the unity and connectedness of all things in the universe back to their Creator. It also serves as a reminder of the importance of patience and persistence, as one drop of water can create a larger impact with time.
